meaning.en: (organic chemistry) An organophosphate insecticide, [dethoxyphosphinothioylthio)methylthio]-diethoxy-thioxophosphorane, that is known to neutralise the neural enzyme acetylcholinesterase.
meaning.vi: (hóa học hữu cơ) Thuốc trừ côn trùng hữu cơ, [dethoxyphosphinothioylthio) methylthio] -diethoxy-thioxophosphorane, được biết là vô hiệu hóa enzym thần kinh acetylcholinesterase.
